result.summary: The page layout is largely intact, but one prominent visual defect stands out: the hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' fails to load and shows a generic broken-image placeholder icon on a gray box. A secondary, minor issue is the low-contrast favorite (heart) button overlaid on that light placeholder. Horizontal clipping of carousel items and the bottom-cut pizza card were treated as intended behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' is missing. Instead of food photography, a large light-gray rectangle with a broken-image icon is displayed, making the card look unfinished and inconsistent with the pizza card below it.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/loading pipeline and add a proper fallback (e.g., a branded skeleton shimmer or a cuisine-specific illustration) so a broken-image glyph is never shown to users. Also verify lazy-loading and error handling for remote images.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the Tokumaru card is a white outline icon on a medium-gray circle sitting on a light-gray placeholder, giving weak contrast compared to the same button on the dark pizza image below.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent semi-opaque dark scrim behind the heart button (as on the pizza card) or a filled icon variant so it remains clearly visible and meets contrast requirements on any background, including light or missing images.
